name: quake-q
description: Renders the letter "q" in the editor in the pixel style of the Quake 1 font. Only the q; the rest of the text is unchanged.

quakeQ.enabled.description: Render the letter q in the Quake 1 style.

quakeQ.includeUppercase.description: Also apply the style to the uppercase Q.

quakeQ.color.description: Top color of the q gradient (CSS hex).

quakeQ.shadowColor.description: Bottom color of the q gradient (CSS hex).

quakeQ.verticalOffset.description: Vertical adjustment of the q in pixels (positive = lower), in case it does not line up with your font.

quakeQ.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Optional: name of a Quake font **installed on your system** (e.g. `DpQuake`). When set, that font is used for the q instead of the bundled pixel glyph.
